note: The single most important line for this database's purpose. He states a falsification condition for his own claim in advance: if the drought is not happening, call it an off-word. Nowhere else in 1667 extracted passages does he do that. Recorded verbatim in the quote so it cannot be lost.
Third February date now live with no content on any of them: the 3rd, the 24th and the 25th. Kept separate from february-3-budget because it is a different day, and a system edge records the pattern.
Storm is not distinguished as weather or metaphor and he says he does not know why he keeps seeing it, so nothing here can be scored.
The actors are Daniel 10 territorial spirits, so the claim is about something unobservable by construction. Only the Iran and Iraq reading can be checked, and he does not make it explicit.
He says outright he cannot describe what he saw. Recorded as an image with no interpretation so a later reading can be compared against it.

Dates the sight to 6 July 2014, the same date given for the volume-turning technology and, in a different year, for the Pope and Ukraine word. He hedges the identification himself with who I believe was.
The tulip is the standard image of a financial mania and he does not gloss it, so the reading is left open.
Places the responsibility for an absent blessing on the listener's stinginess, which is the same structure as many-hands-light-work.
Names states, including Michigan, and dates the call to Biden's term. Both halves checkable, and the prior video should be in this corpus. Flagged for the evidence pass.
Adds the mechanism: they need both chambers to impeach, so a narrow House hold blocks it. Consistent with the 27 January call, which makes this the settled version and red-wave-2026 the outlier.
Hot is not distinguished as diplomatic, military or literal, but the month and the place are both specific, which is more than most.
Predates the channel by five years, so it cannot be checked in this corpus and probably cannot be checked anywhere. The date is worked out on air between two people rather than recalled cleanly.
A claimed same-day hit with a specific mechanism, mining to back the dollar against BRICS. The prior telling is checkable in this corpus. Goes to the evidence pass.
Keep the House so impeachment fails, Senate in jeopardy. Third consistent telling of the same split in three weeks.
A real escalation on the December telling: mass casualties where before it was an attack on the temple. Still no date.
The key to the colour sightings, which are otherwise uninterpretable. Applies retroactively to the purple over the Olympics and the purple three.
Second time in a fortnight he plays an original recording on air instead of paraphrasing it. The 16 January 2025 video is in this corpus, so the check is available to anyone.
The smallness is stated deliberately and does real work: a brief opportunity missed is not a failed forecast.
Subject without direction. Any economic year satisfies it.

The bumblebees from 30 December return as queen bees and the outcome is now stated: I am removing her. She has never been named across four tellings, and in December he said she might not even be in Minnesota.
The clearest statement of the call in the corpus: House stays Republican, Senate flips blue. It can fail on a single night in November.
He counts the hours to the confirming post, 248, which is unusually precise for a fulfilment claim and makes it checkable at both ends.
The accounting is after death, so as in the November telling nothing here can be checked.
Applies it to pastors specifically, with church finances and sex scandals named.
He notes himself that he repeats a lot but there is always a new face, which is a fair account of how the same words circulate.
The condition puts any failure on the listener's own behaviour.
